# Test: grove switch substring matching ignores a detached worktree's placeholder branch
setup_workspace alpha

exec grove add alpha
exec git worktree add --detach ../tmp HEAD

cd $WORK/workspace/main

# The detached worktree carries a commit sha as its placeholder branch; only its
# directory name may match, so this stays unambiguous.
exec grove switch alph
stdout '[/\\]workspace[/\\]alpha$'
! stderr .

# Its directory name still matches by substring.
exec grove switch tm
stdout '[/\\]workspace[/\\]tmp$'
! stderr .
